$comment: Fixture. Deliberately fails C11: no 'scope' object, so the profile does not say what kind of subject it describes or which lifecycle stages of reported data it will accept. A consumer cannot tell whether it applies to the thing they hold, and a document reporting nothing but intentions would conform. Everything else is well-formed.
title: Fixture - C11 no scope

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the checker requires a scope declaration.
